images.filename: Lepanto. Matrakçı Nasuh, Tarih-i Sultân Bâyezid, Ottoman, circa 1540, Topkapı Palace Museum Library, R. 1272, 21v-22r.jpg
images.caption:
Lepanto. Matrakçı Nasuh, Tarih-i Sultân Bâyezid, Ottoman, circa 1540, Topkapı Palace Museum Library, R. 1272, 21v-22r
"The remaining four town views in the History of Sultan Bayezid represent ports in the Morea (southern Greece) that Bayezid captured from the Venetians in 1499: Lepanto (Inebahtı, fol. 21b–22a), Modon (fol. 24b–25a), Koron (fol. 26a, Plate3), and Navarino (Anavarin, fol. 26b)." in (February 2008). "Representations of the Frontier in Ottoman Town Views of the Sixteenth Century". Imago Mundi 60 (1): 11. DOI:10.1080/03085690701669194.
